info.description: Command line interface for Runway generation, task, upload, document, voice, realtime, workflow, organization, and avatar APIs.

options.name: --json
options.description: Full JSON request body, @path to a JSON file, or '-' for stdin. Overrides friendly options.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Submit the task and print the task ID without waiting or downloading outputs. [default: False]

options.name: --poll-interval-seconds
options.description: Polling interval when --wait is set. [default: 5]

options.name: --retry-on-internal-error
options.description: Retry up to N times when the server returns an INTERNAL.* failure code (transient server flakes such as INTERNAL.BAD_OUTPUT.CODE01). Other failure codes are not retried. [default: 0]

options.name: --retry-backoff-seconds
options.description: Base delay in seconds between retries when --retry-on-internal-error fires. [default: 5]

arguments.name: PROMPT
arguments.description: Prompt text. Multiple words are joined, so quotes are optional.

commands.name: short-video
commands.description: Expand a scenario into keyframe prompts and generate a multi-shot short video.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file or directory. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --name
options.description: Optional run name used for the segment directory and final mp4 filename. Replaces the timestamp stem (e.g., "v4" produces runway-short-video-v4/runway-short-video-v4.mp4). Ignored when --output is an explicit file path.

options.name: --auto-name
options.description: Auto-generate --name as <prefix><N+1> by scanning the resolved --output directory for existing runway-short-video-<prefix><N>.* siblings (e.g., "v" emits v4 if v3 already exists). Alias: --name-prefix. Mutually exclusive with --name.

options.name: --ratio
options.description: Short-video ratio/resolution. Defaults to the plan value or 1280:720.

options.name: --model
options.description: Video model. Text: gen4.5, veo3.1, veo3.1-fast, veo3. Image: gen4.5, gen4-turbo, gen3a-turbo, veo3.1, veo3.1-fast, veo3.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Optional video duration in seconds.

options.name: --shots
options.description: Number of planned shots to generate. Supported range: 1-6. [default: 3]

options.name: --style
options.description: Optional shared visual style applied to every planned shot.

options.name: --audio
options.description: Enable per-shot generated audio when the selected model supports it. [default: False]

options.name: --seed
options.description: Optional seed for repeatable generations.

options.name: --public-figure-threshold
options.description: Content moderation public figure threshold: auto or low.

options.name: --plan-only
options.description: Only print the scenario, keyframes, and prompts; do not call the Runway API. [default: False]

options.name: --no-interactive
options.description: Skip the marketing-brief questionnaire. Defaults to interactive when stdin is a terminal; auto-skipped when stdin is redirected. [default: False]

options.name: --keyframes
options.description: Generate a high-quality keyframe still per shot via the chosen image model (gemini-image3-pro, gpt-image-2, gen4-image-turbo, ...) and animate it with image-to-video instead of pure text-to-video. Picks the closest supported aspect to --ratio for the image model and uses --model for the video pass.

options.name: --planner
options.description: Short-video scenario planner: auto, claude, codex, or deterministic. Defaults to RUNWAY_SHORT_VIDEO_PLANNER or auto.

options.name: --planner-model
options.description: External planner model. Defaults to RUNWAY_SHORT_VIDEO_PLANNER_MODEL, or opus for Claude.

options.name: --planner-tools
options.description: External planner tool access: read-only or none. Defaults to RUNWAY_SHORT_VIDEO_PLANNER_TOOLS or read-only.

options.name: --planner-timeout-seconds
options.description: External planner timeout in seconds. Defaults to RUNWAY_SHORT_VIDEO_PLANNER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or 180.

options.name: --no-concat
options.description: Leave downloaded shot segments separate instead of trying to concatenate them with ffmpeg. [default: False]

options.name: --ffmpeg
options.description: Optional ffmpeg binary path used to concatenate downloaded short-video shot segments.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Submit the task and print the task ID without waiting or downloading outputs. [default: False]

options.name: --poll-interval-seconds
options.description: Polling interval when --wait is set. [default: 5]

options.name: --retry-on-internal-error
options.description: Retry up to N times when the server returns an INTERNAL.* failure code on any shot. Recipes default to 2 because losing a single shot to a transient flake should not abort a multi-shot recipe. [default: 2]

options.name: --retry-backoff-seconds
options.description: Base delay in seconds between retries when --retry-on-internal-error fires. [default: 5]

arguments.name: SCENARIO
arguments.description: Scenario text to expand into a short multi-shot video.
